name: LongMemEval Benchmark
description: Run the LongMemEval long-term memory benchmark against this Spore's recall pipeline. The first run downloads the dataset from HuggingFace (oracle ~15 MB / small ~277 MB / medium ~2.7 GB); each run is wrapped in a fresh ephemeral graph so it doesn't pollute your real memory. Results land in <dataDir>/longmemeval-results.json. Recommended with Enhanced Recall enabled.
